paper.title: Noncanonical Short-Latency Auditory Pathway Directly Activates Deep Cortical Layers
paper.support: Auditory stimulus protocol, processed spike-sorting methods, 26 MGN mice and 1-ms latency analysis resolution; not proof of every deposited cluster's observation support.

retained_authenticated_metadata_census.scope: Authenticated file identities, anatomical/quality assignments, categorical support, schema and clock-reference metadata. No spike values or full trial timestamp arrays were opened in that census.

normalized_support.normalization: All source-labelled good+mua clusters in literal named regions; all declared source trial rows; unassigned clusters audited separately.

source_semantics.clock: NWB 2.7.0 time values share the declared timestamps_reference_time, equal to session_start_time in all retained records. Exact authentic trial values and anchor interpretation remain a preparation gate.
source_semantics.observation: No units/obs_intervals or continuous recorded electrical signal was present in the inspected MGN release. Absence of obs_intervals neither proves interruption nor verifies complete coverage.
source_semantics.anatomy: Literal source labels remain separate. Physical depth conversion and CSD are outside this condition.
source_semantics.quality: good and mua are retained source-cluster labels; no response-dependent eligibility is introduced.
source_semantics.identity: Source-declared animal grouping is accepted from the paper and authenticated MGN subject IDs, with unknown aliases and any future alias correction explicitly retained.
